steps: Peel the sweet potato and cut it into 1 cm cubes.
Combine rice and water in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover and cook for 18 minutes until water is absorbed.
Warm olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add sweet potato cubes and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tender.
Stir in cooked lentils, cumin, and turmeric, mixing to coat evenly.
Pour in vegetable broth and simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture is saucy and fragrant.
Spoon lentil mixture over rice in bowls. Mash portions for babies under 9 months. Keeps refrigerated for 3 days.
